name: Tang dynasty
summary: Cosmopolitan imperial period with abundant court, tomb, Buddhist and trade-related visual material; avoid collapsing all three centuries into one fashion moment.

occasions.note: Festival staging details need narrower evidence for strict reconstruction.

wardrobe.text: high-waisted long skirts and layered court dress appear in Tang visual culture; exact ensemble varies by decade/status

hairstyle_headwear.text: elaborate updos are well represented; choose ornament density by status and date

makeup_grooming.text: period cosmetics and forehead/face adornment vary; use only when evidence or user strictness supports them

jewelry.text: gold/silver/hair ornaments appropriate to elite contexts

architecture.text: palace/courtyard architecture with timber construction and tiled roofs

interior_furniture.text: stools and imported forms can appear in cosmopolitan elite contexts

food_drink_tableware.text: ceramic, metal and lacquer dining vessels

transportation.text: horses are a strong Tang visual/cultural anchor

writing_calligraphy.text: Tang calligraphic culture; use verified inscriptions only

ritual_custom.text: court ceremonial and Buddhist devotional settings should remain role-specific

lighting_technology.text: lanterns/oil lamps/candles as motivated night sources

flora_season.text: peony associations are popular but should not be treated as mandatory documentary décor

incompatible_or_anachronistic.text: Ming blue-and-white as default Tang tableware
generic xianxia glow presented as historical

prompt_fragments.portrait: Render an adult Tang court subject as a living person in a coherent, role-specific ensemble; keep ornament, furniture and light motivated by occasion.
prompt_fragments.lantern: Build the lantern festival as a human social event: warm practical lantern light, layered courtyard depth, attendants/guests in restrained supporting roles, no magical floating lights unless fantasy mode.

sources.supports: 8th-century court figure, clothing layers, sancai, cosmopolitan exchange

scope_note: Foundation pack: use as a bounded starting point, not an encyclopedia.
strict_reconstruction_note: Strict mode should narrow century/reign, capital/region, status, and whether evidence is court, tomb, Buddhist, or literary.
